Illustrative mean T1 and T2* values for four example qubits, with synthetic
cooldown scatter. Squares show a slightly lower illustrative simulation series.
Diamonds show the 2 T1 coherence limit. These are not device measurements. Screen keeps hover. Print is static. The page mode selects
the matching figure.

## Screen

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
from review import bars, for_renderings, show

for_renderings(lambda appearance: show(bars(), reading="screen", appearance=appearance))
```

## Print

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
for_renderings(lambda appearance: show(bars(), reading="print", appearance=appearance))
```
